identity.name: Memory Dumping via comsvcs.dll
identity.summary: An attacker uses comsvcs.dll to dump memory from a target process, potentially extracting credentials or sensitive data. Cortex detects this behavior through process creation and file access patterns.
identity.description: An attacker uses comsvcs.dll to dump memory from a target process, potentially extracting credentials or sensitive data. Cortex detects this behavior through process creation and file access patterns.

payload.code:
cd C:\Windows\System32
msiexec.exe /i C:\temp\malware.msi /quiet
regsvr32.exe /s C:\temp\comsvcs.dll
rundll32.exe C:\temp\comsvcs.dll,Void
